provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Gallerist rules (Eagle-Gryphon Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Player boards around the game board, each by the Gallery of its color; Influence markers on 10
Box office: {n} tickets of each color
Shuffle the contracts facedown on the leftmost Sales office space; 4 faceup on the display
Shuffle the 16 Artist tiles and place them one at a time on spaces matching color and Art form; box any whose space is taken
The first blue Artist drawn is faceup with a white cube on its starting Fame; the rest facedown
A random Artist bonus tile on each Artist; a white Visitor on each red Artist; both Signature tokens beside each Artist
Works of Art shuffled per Art form, faceup by their studios; set the top tile of each stack aside
Random Visitors on each top Work of Art equal to its tickets
Promotion tokens stacked on their numbered Media spaces

byPlayers.1: 8 random Reputation tiles on the upper 4 rows of columns 1 and 3
byPlayers.2: 8 random Reputation tiles on the upper 4 rows of columns 1 and 3
byPlayers.3: 12 random Reputation tiles on the upper 4 rows
byPlayers.4: 12 random Reputation tiles on the upper 4 rows

steps.text: Shuffle the 4 set-aside Works of Art onto {n} easel(s)
4 random Visitors in the Plaza and 1 in each player's Lobby
8 Assistants on the unemployment queue, 2 at desks in the office
Your Reputation tile on the 3rd Art space; take {n} money
Deal each player 1 Art Dealer card and 1 Curator card, kept secret
From the Start Player clockwise: choose a Location and one of its two actions
